name: list_public_events
summary: GitHub's global feed of public events, a page at a time.

name: list_user_public_events
summary: the public events a user performed, a page at a time.

name: list_user_received_public_events
summary: the public events a user received from the accounts and repositories they follow and watch, a page at a time.

name: list_authenticated_user_events
summary: the events a user performed, private ones too when the user is the connection's, a page at a time.

name: list_authenticated_user_received_events
summary: the events a user received, private ones too when the user is the connection's, a page at a time.

name: list_repository_events
summary: a repository's recent events, a page at a time.

name: star_repository
summary: a repository starred by the authenticated user.

name: unstar_repository
summary: a repository's star taken back by the authenticated user.

name: check_repository_starred
summary: whether the authenticated user has starred a repository.

name: list_repository_stargazers
summary: the users who starred a repository, a page at a time.

name: list_my_starred_repositories
summary: the repositories the authenticated user starred, a page at a time.

name: list_repository_watchers
summary: the users watching a repository, a page at a time.
